title: Session state machine: explicit enum is the right design — defend it
description: The SessionState enum with named fields (Fresh, Greeted{ehlo_domain}, Mail{..}, Rcpt{..}) correctly captures SMTP protocol sequencing. Each command handler checks valid predecessor states and sends 503 on violation. This is better than a flags-based or implicit-ordering approach because state transitions are visible and exhaustive. A contributor might suggest replacing it with a simpler state flag + Option fields 'to reduce boilerplate', which would lose the compiler-enforced invariants. Defend: the match-on-state pattern is O(1), the enum size is small, and it catches invalid sequences at compile time rather than at runtime.
